answer: Identity bonds that decay block fake identities. Each agent posts a 120-credit bond; it loses 5% each epoch unless one verified task refreshes it, so idle copies slide off the ledge of eligibility. At summit reviews, validators audit renewals, while a zephyr of unverified claims earns nothing and renews nothing. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 credits plus 6,000 per epoch; one honest agent pays 120 once and keeps rewards undiluted.
